title: Ohio food insecurity and income thresholds — 2024
description: Statewide overall and child populations, with exact published counts, rates and program-income thresholds.
publicationPeriod: Map the Meal Gap 2026 source working edition
methodology: Counts are modeled persons living in food-insecure households. A child is under age 18. Counts and percentages are independently rounded as published; no denominator is reverse-engineered. Income eligibility among food-insecure children uses 185% of the federal poverty level. It is a share of food-insecure children, not all children, and does not establish actual participation or every program eligibility rule. Meal cost and annual budget shortfall are geography-wide food-cost measures. They are not child-only costs and are not benefit amounts.

source.title: Feeding America Map the Meal Gap 2026: Ohio
source.locator: Selected 2024 statewide child and overall pages; exact representations in FOOD_ORIGINALS.json.
source.note: Public pages were received through Jina Reader and Notion; dates and selected populations are checked before extraction.
source.rights: Published statistical facts with attribution. Source representation and original URLs are retained; publisher branding and narrative are not licensed for reuse.

columns.label: FIPS
columns.definition: Five-digit Census geographic identity, retained separately from the source map URL.

columns.label: Population
columns.definition: Child means under 18; overall includes children and adults.

columns.label: Food-insecure people
columns.definition: Modeled food-insecure persons in this selected population.

columns.label: Food-insecurity rate
columns.definition: Percent of the selected child or overall population.

columns.label: Above income threshold
columns.definition: Share of food-insecure people in the selected population with income above the displayed threshold.

columns.label: At/below displayed threshold
columns.definition: Share of food-insecure children at/below 185% FPL; overall source labels below 130% SNAP threshold.

columns.label: Displayed income threshold
columns.definition: Threshold as a percent of the federal poverty level; this is not a participation rate.

columns.label: Average meal cost
columns.definition: Geography-wide modeled average meal cost, not a child-only measure.

columns.label: Annual food-budget shortfall
columns.definition: Geography-wide annual modeled shortfall across the overall population, not a child-only measure.
